title: Don't Say "You're Welcome" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "You're welcome". Say this instead:
• No problem. (casual)
• My pleasure. (polite, warm)
• Anytime. (friendly)
• Don't mention it. (polite)
• Happy to help. (at work)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
